description: Places every handwritten functions/src module by tool/architecture/functions_context_map.json (issue #1350) and checks its imports: platform imports only platform, domain code never imports a surface, a surface never imports another, domain contexts import only earlier contexts; and every collection is written only from the writerContext its tool/contracts/firestore_contract/collections/<id>.json names. Context-order imports and cross-context writes are bounded by the map's ceilings, which may only go down.

rules.title: Functions code is layered into platform, domain contexts and surfaces, and one context writes each collection
rules.instruction: Place new functions/src modules under functions/src/platform/, functions/src/domain/<context>/ or functions/src/surfaces/<surface>/ (or a legacy placement in the map). Domain code never imports a surface; shared helpers go to the owning domain context or platform. Write a collection only from its registry writerContext; other contexts call the owning context's functions inside their transaction. Never raise a ceiling.
